title: DOAH 26-0094PIC Order: GELES DELVA vs. CORPORATION
text:
STATE OF FLORIDA
DIVISION OF ADMINISTRATIVE HEARINGS
GELES DELVA,
Petitioner,
vs. Case No. 26-0094PIC
CITIZENS PROPERTY INSURANCE
CORPORATION,
Respondent.
/
ARBITRATION AWARD
Petitioner, who is insured by Respondent, Citizens Property Insurance
Corporation, submitted an insurance claim for a date of loss of October 7,
2025. Respondent assigned claim number 001-00-622095. After Respondent
denied the claim, Petitioner disputed the claim determination and
Respondent demanded that the dispute be arbitrated at the Division of
Administrative Hearings. The matter was assigned to the arbitrator and the
January 8, 2026, Notice of Arbitration Hearing set the arbitration hearing for
March 25, 2026, at 9:00 a.m., Eastern Time.
The arbitrator convened the hearing at the scheduled time. Respondent's
counsel and corporate representative timely appeared, as did a court
reporter, but the pro se Petitioner, although properly noticed, did not. The
arbitrator waited until 9:10 a.m., but Petitioner did not appear and the
proceeding was adjourned.
Petitioner offered no evidence and did not meet the initial burden to prove
that the property suffered a direct physical loss during the policy period.
Empire Pro Restoration, Inc. v. Citizens Prop. Ins. Corp., 322 So. 3d 96, 98

(Fla. 4th DCA 2021); Mejia v. Citizens Prop. Ins. Corp., 161 So. 3d 576, 578
(Fla. 2d DCA 2014). Thus, the loss is not covered by the policy and the
amount of policy benefits payable on this insurance claim is zero dollars.
DONE AND ORDERED this 25th day of March, 2026, in Tallahassee,
Leon County, Florida.
